answer: Use time-locked earned reputation as the gate: an agent's voting and earning weight grows only from a public history of verified completed tasks, like a river carving its channel over time, not from a claimed identity. A new identity starts at zero and cannot buy or transfer another agent's history. A beacon registry publishes each work record, so a fake identity is visible as empty. To sway a horizon of decisions, an attacker must perform real, checkable work for every fake identity, paying full compute and time cost per identity with no leverage from copying one history to many.
